lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13-14 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-lateral torso, with increased compression observed in the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation (Y-split) identified on the 5th line from the anterior in the upper-mid lateral quadrant; a merging topology is visible on the 10th line in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Abbreviated line segments observed in the posterior flank (lines 11-14) which terminate before reaching the lower ventral boundary. A short, isolated dashed segment is present between lines 1 and 2.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5-6 high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb; density is highest on the mid-haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align on the posterior-most margin of the upper thigh to form a semi-horizontal geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse crescent on the lower cervical/upper thoracic region; white horizontal bands on distal limb segments above the hooves; white interior fringe on large pinnae.
